mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dialogue_session ( session_id, owner_id, title, status, latest_request_id, latest_query_text, latest_summary_text, run_count, finished_run_count, failed_run_count, started_at, last_active_at, create_time, update_time, deleted ) VALUES ( #{sessionId}, #{ownerId}, #{title}, #{status}, #{latestRequestId}, #{latestQueryText}, #{latestSummaryText}, #{runCount}, #{finishedRunCount}, #{failedRunCount}, #{startedAt}, #{lastActiveAt}, NOW(), NOW(), 0 ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE owner_id = COALESCE(owner_id, VALUES(owner_id)), title = VALUES(title), status = VALUES(status), latest_request_id = VALUES(latest_request_id), latest_query_text = VALUES(latest_query_text), latest_summary_text = VALUES(latest_summary_text), run_count = VALUES(run_count), finished_run_count = VALUES(finished_run_count), failed_run_count = VALUES(failed_run_count), last_active_at = VALUES(last_active_at), update_time = NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE dialogue_session session_head JOIN ( SELECT ranked.session_id, ranked.request_id, ranked.query_text, ranked.final_summary_text, ranked.status, ranked.started_at, ranked.finished_at, ranked.error_code FROM ( SELECT dialogue_run.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY dialogue_run.session_id ORDER BY COALESCE(dialogue_run.started_at, dialogue_run.create_time) DESC, dialogue_run.id DESC ) AS row_number_in_session FROM dialogue_run WHERE dialogue_run.deleted = 0 ) ranked WHERE ranked.row_number_in_session = 1 ) latest_run ON latest_run.session_id = session_head.session_id JOIN ( SELECT dialogue_run.session_id, COUNT(*) AS run_count, SUM(CASE WHEN dialogue_run.status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS finished_run_count, SUM(CASE WHEN dialogue_run.status IN (2, 3, 4) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_run_count FROM dialogue_run WHERE dialogue_run.deleted = 0 GROUP BY dialogue_run.session_id ) run_totals ON run_totals.session_id = session_head.session_id SET session_head.status = latest_run.status, session_head.latest_request_id = latest_run.request_id, session_head.latest_query_text = latest_run.query_text, session_head.latest_summary_text = latest_run.final_summary_text, session_head.run_count = run_totals.run_count, session_head.finished_run_count = run_totals.finished_run_count, session_head.failed_run_count = run_totals.failed_run_count, session_head.started_at = COALESCE(session_head.started_at, latest_run.started_at), session_head.last_active_at = COALESCE(latest_run.finished_at, latest_run.started_at, session_head.last_active_at), session_head.update_time = NOW() WHERE session_head.deleted = 0 AND session_head.status = 0 AND latest_run.status IN (2, 3, 4) AND latest_run.error_code = #{errorCode}
